args.command: echo '=== USERS ==='; id zenui 2>&1 || true; id zenops 2>&1 || true; echo '=== NODE ==='; node --version 2>&1 || /opt/node/bin/node --version 2>&1 || true; echo '=== CODEX ==='; command -v codex || true; codex --version 2>&1 || true; echo '=== ZENUI HOME ==='; getent passwd zenui || true; ls -la /var/lib/zenui/.codex 2>&1 || true; find /var/lib/zenui -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name 'config.toml' -o -name 'hooks.json' -o -name '.mcp.json' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo '=== CODEX MCP HELP ==='; runuser -u zenui -- env HOME=/var/lib/zenui codex mcp --help 2>&1 | head -120 || true; echo '=== CODEX MCP LIST ==='; runuser -u zenui -- env HOME=/var/lib/zenui codex mcp list 2>&1 || true
